description: Defines the MultiLogCTVerifier class for verifying Signed Certificate Timestamps from multiple logs, including its nested CTLogProvider class, methods for setting logs and verifying SCTs, and internal data structures.

classes.name: MultiLogCTVerifier
classes.description: A verifier for Signed Certificate Timestamps from multiple logs, capable of initialization, log management, and SCT verification.

classes.name: MultiLogCTVerifier::CTLogProvider
classes.description: Provides a callback mechanism to supply a list of log verifiers to the MultiLogCTVerifier.

methods.name: SetLogs
methods.description: Sets the list of log verifiers for the verifier.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies SCTs for a given certificate and hostname.

methods.name: VerifySCTs
methods.description: Verifies a list of SCTs against an expected entry.

methods.name: VerifySingleSCT
methods.description: Verifies a single SCT against all logs.
